table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(max(item.customicode))) END,   
         aliasname=max(item.customicode),   
		alternatecustomicode = max(saledetail.alternatecustomicode),   
         packingdesc= 
			CASE 
				WHEN len(max(saledetail.alternatecustomicode)) > 0 THEN 
					(SELECT AA.PackingDesc FROM AlternateItemAlias AA WHERE AA.CustomICode = max(saledetail.alternatecustomicode)) 
				ELSE max(item.packingdesc)
			END,
		salecatcode=max(saleledger.salecatcode),   
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
         address = max(dbo.customer.address1),   
         address2= max(dbo.customer.address2), 
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = max(dbo.saleledger.headerno), 
		 cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
		headerinvno=max(dbo.saleledger.headerinvno), 
         date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         gcode =max(saledetail.gcode),   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = max(saledetail.batch),   
         expiry = min(saledetail.expiry),   
         looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty),   
         bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),   
         packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),   
         packunits= CASE 
				WHEN len(max(saledetail.alternatecustomicode)) > 0 THEN 
					(SELECT MAX(CAST(AA.Qty AS INT)) FROM AlternateItemAlias AA WHERE AA.CustomICode = max(saledetail.alternatecustomicode)) 
				ELSE max(saledetail.packunits)
			END,
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
         salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
         Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
         posted=max(saleledger.posted),   
         balance=isnull(max(saleledger.balance),0),
			amt=max(saleledger.amt),   
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),   
         custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno)  ,
			dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			printwaranty=max(dbo.saleledger.printwaranty),
			printbatch=max(dbo.saleledger.printbatch),
			printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),			
			messagedesc=(select description from message where messagecode=max(saleledger.messagecode)),
			salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=max(saleledger.smancode)),
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
			serverdate=getdate()

    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			/*saleledger.headerno,*/
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.custrefno, 
			saledetail.icode,
			saledetail.saleprice,
			saledetail.itemflatdisc,
			saledetail.discperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.salestax,
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name,
			dbo.users.username
ORDER BY 
			MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)
/*ORDER BY dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL*/

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)
